metadata.description: Custom Claude Code plugins for issue-driven development workflow automation

plugins.name: fathom
plugins.description: Two agent skills, scaffold and execute, that carry a tracker issue from requirements to an open code review, on GitHub or any other forge with an adapter. Works with Asana or Linear, runs on Claude Code and Kiro, tracks tasks in beads or a committed markdown checklist, and resumes from repository state.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: One agent skill that carries the current branch from working tree to merged release: it resolves the project's own verification pipeline, runs verify until clean, then commits, pushes, opens a pull request, reviews it with a subagent and the pull-request bot in parallel, lands each pass's blocking fixes in one batched push and confirms it until nothing blocking remains, squash-merges, watches the release, and cleans up. No tracker required.
